acip: RTAGS DANG PO SLA, GNYIS PA MA GRUB NA, YOD PA DANG MA 'BREL BA YANG YIN, YOD PA DANG 'GAL BA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PAR THAL, YOD PA DANG 'GAL BA YIN NA YOD PA DANG 'BREL BA YIN PAS KHYAB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags dang po sla, gnyis pa ma grub na, yod pa dang ma 'brel ba yang yin, yod pa dang 'gal ba yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med par thal, yod pa dang 'gal ba yin na yod pa dang 'brel ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir
english: The first part of this last reason is easily accepted.  But suppose you disagree to the second part. In that case, let's consider something which is not related to existence. It is so the case that there exists no example of something which is both not related to existence, and also contradictory to existence; Because if something is contradictory to existence, it is always related to existence.
